description: This file defines the IQueueAdapterFactory interface, which provides methods for creating and retrieving queue-related components such as adapters, cache, queue mappers, and failure handlers within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates a queue adapter asynchronously based on the stream provider configuration.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires a delivery failure handler for a specified queue.
